name: Mesuinu Hatsujouki ~Kageriyuku Nichijou~
original_name: 牝犬発情記 ～かげりゆく日常～
source: Miyuki is a full-time housewife who spends her days waiting for her husband to come home from work. They used to be a happy newly-married couple, but their marriage has stagnated, they barely speak to each other and Miyuki is beginning to feel lonely. One day an acquaintance of her husband comes by, he is going on a long business trip and asks if Miyuki can take care of his dog while he is away, and Miyuki agrees to this. She now spends her days walking, feeding and bathing the dog, and it doesn't take long before the sexually starved Miyuki starts to take an interest in her new companion.
translation: 美雪是一位全职主妇，每天等待着丈夫下班回家。他们曾经是一对幸福的新婚夫妇，但婚姻已经陷入了停滞，两人几乎不说话，美雪开始感到孤独。一天，丈夫的一位熟人来访，他要出长差，问美雪能否在他不在时帮忙照顾他的狗，美雪答应了。她现在每天遛狗、喂狗、给狗洗澡，没过多久，性饥渴的美雪就开始对这位新伙伴产生了兴趣。
